content: this is a summary of a civil case that took place in the plunge district court the defendant has been ordered to pay a stamp duty and legal fees the court has decided to divide the matrimonial property specifically the apartment basement between the claimant and the defendant any debts owed to third parties will be the defendants responsibility the text discusses various articles from the civil code related to matrimonial property the applicant is seeking a divorce and the court will decide on the division of property and other obligations the court has upheld the action to dissolve the marriage due to faults on the part of both spouses the court has divided the matrimonial property between the parties involved the defendant has recognized their obligation towards a credit union and enforcement proceedings have been initiated the remainder of the action has been dismissed and the defendant is ordered to pay a stamp duty and legal aid costs

metadata.cost: - € 146,00 (stamp duty) + € 158,27 (legal fees) to be borne by the defendant
